rules.rule: a matched instrument comparison is feasible at n available independent files only if n >= min_independent_files, the confirmation calibration is complete and within tolerance (type-I and primary coverage) at the largest calibrated n_files <= n, the maximum withholding rate over the non-drift scenarios at that n_files is <= max_withholding_rate, the power at the medium effect is >= min_power_medium_effect, and the development-data dependence verdict is not inconclusive; otherwise the output is a feasibility failure with its reasons, never an artificial four-file significance claim

decision_rule.output: FROZEN_CALIBRATION.json in the run root, written by the pilot reducer only when every pilot cell is present; confirmation cells refuse to run without it and record its digest
decision_rule.purpose: choose the bootstrap replicate setting (per-file joint, two-stage file, block-curve replicates) before any confirmation cell is drawn; the block grids are the archived ones and are frozen unchanged
decision_rule.rule: freeze 'reduced' iff on EVERY pilot scenario the coverage of the primary contrast, the withholding rate and the any-supported rate differ between the two settings by at most the reference setting's Wilson half-width (paired seeds); otherwise freeze 'archived'

frozen_calibration.statement: Replicate setting frozen before any confirmation cell is drawn; tolerances were fixed in the protocol and are copied here unchanged.  A development_only freeze is never citable.

tolerances.applies_to: coverage: the primary contrast raw-bin|empca on every confirmation scenario (pca|empca and zero|empca reported); type-I: every null claim on every null scenario and the any-null-claim rate
tolerances.evaluation: a scenario is within tolerance when its Wilson interval is not entirely outside the band; tolerances are fixed here, before the validation scenarios, and are copied unchanged into FROZEN_CALIBRATION.json

statement: Synthetic calibration of the archived T22 inference pipeline.  It measures coverage, type-I error, power and the withholding rate of the declared procedure on simulated files whose dependence, heterogeneity and calibration uncertainty were declared in advance.  It cannot establish the adequacy of that procedure on unexamined instrument data, whose dependence structure is not known; the archived T22 verdicts remain withheld and nothing here changes them.
